title: 第八章 这游戏居然还能吃饭！
content_zh:
【活性物质提取器使用说明书：】
【1.活性物质为合成克隆体的主要原料，包括且不限于构成人体所需的矿物质、20种常见氨基酸以及2种稀有氨基酸等等。】
【2.活性物质提取器使用原料为动物尸体，其中以脊索动物门哺乳纲灵长目最优，提取效率高达90%，非灵长目次之，无脊椎动物门提取效率最低，低于10%。】
【3.提取效率同时与腐坏程度有关。】
随着招募玩家的任务完成，奖励和说明书一起到账。
404号避难所内。
楚光一边看着系统投射在他视网膜上的说明书，一边端详着传送带旁，那台长得和棺材一样的铁疙瘩。
根据说明书上的介绍，这玩意儿是用来生产“合成克隆人的原料”——也就是“活性物质”的装置。
简单来说，功能类似于尸体回收？
不过看这说明书上的描述，异种的尸体似乎也在回收范围内。
大致了解了这玩意儿的用法，楚光用从外面捡来的板车，将它拖到了电梯上，跟着电梯一起回到了地表。
他可不想将尸体弄进避难所。
至于电力。
总会有办法。
电梯缓缓上升，停稳开门。
就在他拖着板车从电梯里出来的时候，小柒的声音几乎让是同一时间从楼上传来。
“主人！”
“怎么了？”
“您的玩家那边好像有情况……一只黑色的大鸟正在袭击他们！在疗养院的北侧！”
黑色的大鸟？

楚光先是一愣，脸色随即一变，立刻丢下手中的板车，朝着疗养院外的方向赶去。
“卧槽？夜哥牛批啊。”
“刚才那个前滚翻躲闪有点东西！”
“滚蛋，老子特么是被吓的！别傻站着了，快，快来帮我一把！”
疗养院北边的树林。
一只黑色的鸟站在十米高的树杈上，锐利的视线死死地锁定着地面上的一众玩家。
鸟腿微曲，风筝大的翅膀向后折叠，随时准备弹射起步。
听到夜十这边的动静之后，另外三个玩家立刻放下手中的活儿，拿着斧子朝这边赶了过来。
可能是见地上人多势众，那只黑鸟没有立刻展开第二轮的俯冲，而是停在众人够不着的地方伺机而动。
狂风俯下身，在地上捡起一根黑色的羽毛，盯着看了两眼。
“有点像乌鸦。”
“乌鸦有这么大？！”瞟了一眼旁边木头上的抓痕，夜十一边后退，一边心有余悸地说道。
“这玩意儿应该就是异种了……伽马射线或者别的东西产生的突变体，我在官网上看过设定。”方长谨慎地盯着他，一刻不敢放松。
夜十：“官网有设定？！不是就一个预约页面吗？”
狂风：“那是几天前了……昨天官网更新了新功能，你都没看吗？”
“先别扯淡了，咱现在该咋办？就这么干耗着？”夜十紧张地又退了一步。
现在离那鸟最近的变成狂风了。
四人一鸟陷入僵持。
就在这时，“嗖”的一道破空声划过四人头顶，朝着那只大鸟笔直地砸了过去。
“呷！”

石头虽然没有砸中，却是将那大鸟吓了一跳，扑腾着飞起，跳到了另一根树杈上。
当它扑腾着翅膀，在树枝上终于稳定身形，却是看见地上那人又是捡起一颗石头，朝着自己扔了过来。
大鸟彻底怒了。
它还是头一回见到，在这片属于它的领地里，敢对自己这么嚣张的家伙。
弯曲的双腿猛地发力，从树杈上腾空跃起的它就像一发出膛的炮弹，一头扎向了楚光。
锐利的爪子前伸，犹如张开的钩锁。
然而畜生终归是畜生，就算再长一个脑袋，它也不可能读懂那嘴角翘起的一丝嘲讽。
丢开了手上的石块，楚光熟练地一把抓住插在地上的钢管，将锋利的那头狠狠地扎了出去。
电光石火之间，根本来不及闪避。
虽然那大鸟在看到楚光捡起自己没见过的家伙的一瞬间，惊觉地扑扇翅膀想要拉开距离，然而在惯性地作用下基本不可能来得及。
那根水管犹如一杆标枪，狠狠地扎进了它的胸口。
“呷——！”
凄厉地叫声在林间回荡。
带血的羽毛四散飞舞。
看着挣扎飞走的大鸟，楚光默不作声地上前，从地上捡起了鲜血淋漓的水管。
“这可不是乌鸦。”
“它的学名叫隼……大概在两百年前。”
四名玩家目瞪口呆地看着他，被这套行云流水地动作给怔住了。
好强！！
然而他们并不知道，对于绝对大多数能在废土上独自行走的幸存者来说，这种程度的身手不过是基操罢了。

这五个月，楚光别的没学会，就是把扔标枪的本领给练到家了，十米之内指哪扎哪。
否则他也没机会站在这里装逼了。
“隼？！有这么大？”狂风吃惊道，这颠覆了他对鸟的认知。
方丈咽了口唾沫。
“因为伽马射线？”
“不只是伽马射线。病毒，细菌，基因武器……各种因素，共同造成了我们今天看到的一切。当然，异种只是我们面临的威胁之一。某些情况下，人会比它们更危险。”
楚光抬头看了一眼四名玩家身前的松树，接着说道。
“刚才那只隼，应该是在这树上做了窝，难怪你们这么多人它都不走。”
一般来说，飞禽是很少主动挑衅比自己庞大的地面生物，它们的食谱主要以变异蟑螂或者老鼠、松鼠为主。
那畜生虽然飞走了，但飞不远，估计就在附近哪棵树上等死。
这种带尖儿的水管，虽然穿透力不强，但里面的镂空是天然的放血槽，只要在身上扎了个洞，那几乎是必死的。
别说是鸟了，就算是人挨着了，也很难将伤口缝合好。
夜十惭愧地低下了头。
“抱歉……我光顾着砍木头了，没注意到。”
“不用抱歉，”楚光抬头看了一眼，“鸟蛋可是个好东西。”
一会儿有口福了。
楚光的判断很快得到了验证。
在一颗歪脖子树下，他寻到了那只断气儿的黑鸟。
用匕首给它放了血，剥干净羽毛，楚光将它丢进铁锅，搁在了砖块摆成的灶子上，往灶子下面塞进干树枝和枯叶，拿之前买来的火柴点燃。
炊烟升起。

在水煮开之前，楚光将焯了水的大鸟从锅里捞出，串上钢条，直接架在火上烤。
一起烤的还有那几个鸟蛋。
没有盐，也没有香料。
但即便如此，也比煮的半青不熟的青麦糊糊好太多了。
“这玩意儿……能吃吗？”
看着铁架上那只“突变体”，夜十本能的感到排斥，但奈何香气不断地撩拨，还是不争气地咽了口唾沫。
游戏里居然能吃饭！
这对于吃货来说，绝对是个意外惊喜。
而这也让他瞬间感觉到，这一上午的辛苦都值得了。
“熟了就能吃，哪些东西不能吃我会告诉你们的。”楚光慢悠悠地转着烤架，让食物的每一面都充分受热。
在废土上能吃到野味儿的机会不多。
哪怕偶尔能像这样逮着能吃的野味儿，也会因为缺乏保存手段很快坏掉。
在这里，盐是比电力更紧缺的物资。
尤其是对于生活在清泉市这样内陆城市的幸存者们来说，用大量的盐来腌制食物是不太现实的。
至于冰箱这种东西，听说镇长大人的城堡里有一台，但楚光也只是听说过，并没有真正见过。
当然了，幸存者们也不是完全没有办法。
比如隔壁幸存者据点——布朗先生的农庄，会生产一种富含焦油和醇醛酮等芳香族化合物的烟叶，即使在没有盐巴的情况下熏制，也能够延长几个月的食物保质期。
“管理者大人，请问我们到底需要多少木材。”
等待美食烹饪好是一种煎熬。
为了转移对食物注意力，方长主动

听到这个问题，楚光随口回了句。
“有多少砍多少。”
玩家们面面相觑，没多少干劲的样子。
楚光一开始也没太在意，不过就在这时，却是忽然想到了一件事情。
他们是“玩家”，也就是“局外人”。
和已经穿越到这边来的自己不同，他们随时都可以离开这里，并不存在生存的紧迫性。
就算自己告诉他们储备木材的重要性，他们也根本不会真正地理解这句话到底意味着什么。
玩家的身份决定了，他们思考问题的角度和自己不同。就算他们不介意肝，也很难为没有回报的事情持续付出。
有任务。
自然也得有奖励才行。
“让我想想……”
摸着下巴的楚光陷入了沉思。
忽然间，他想到了一个点子。
“下午四点，我们统计一下今天的成果。”
“胳膊粗的树，每一米长，1点贡献。大腿粗的树，每一米，2点贡献——”
然而让楚光没想到的是，他的话音才刚落下，四条端着碗的咸鱼，噌地一声站了起来。
“管理者大人，我突然觉得不是很饿。”
“我也是。”
“反正开饭还有一会儿，我再去撸两棵树！”
“我突然想砍点什么！”

楚光：“……？”
他还没说这贡献点能用来干啥呢……
content_en:
[Active substance extractor instruction manual:]
[1. Active substances are the main raw materials for synthetic clones, including but not limited to minerals required by the human body, 20 common amino acids, 2 rare amino acids, etc. 】
[2. The active substance extractor uses animal carcasses as raw materials. Among them, the primates of the phylum Chordata and the class Mammalia are the best, with an extraction efficiency of up to 90%, followed by non-primates. The extraction efficiency of the phylum Invertebrates is the lowest, less than 10%. 】
【3. Extraction efficiency is also related to the degree of spoilage. 】
As the task of recruiting players is completed, rewards and instructions will arrive together.
Inside Vault 404.
While Chu Guang was reading the instructions projected on his retina by the system, he was also looking at the iron lump next to the conveyor belt that looked like a coffin.
According to the description in the manual, this thing is a device used to produce "raw materials for synthetic human cloning" - that is, "active substances."
Simply put, the function is similar to corpse recycling?
However, judging from the description in this manual, it seems that the bodies of alien species are also within the scope of recovery.
After roughly understanding how to use this thing, Chu Guang used the cart he picked up from outside to drag it to the elevator, and followed the elevator back to the surface.
He didn't want to get the body into the shelter.
As for electricity.
There is always a way.
The elevator rose slowly, stopped and opened the door.
Just as he was dragging the trolley out of the elevator, Xiaoqi's voice came from upstairs almost at the same time.
"Master!"
"What's wrong?"
"There seems to be something going on with your players...a big black bird is attacking them! On the north side of the sanatorium!"
Big black bird?
Chu Guang was stunned for a moment, then his expression changed. He immediately dropped the cart in his hand and hurried towards the outside of the nursing home.
"What the hell? Brother Ye is so awesome."
"There was something about that forward roll and dodge just now!"
"Get out of here, I'm really scared! Stop standing there, come on, come and help me!"
The woods north of the sanatorium.
A black bird stood on a tree branch ten meters high, its sharp eyes fixed on the players on the ground.
The bird's legs are slightly bent, and the kite's large wings are folded back, ready to launch at any time.
After hearing the movement on Ye Shi's side, the other three players immediately put down their work and rushed towards this side with axes.
Perhaps seeing the large number of people on the ground, the black bird did not immediately launch a second dive, but stopped at a place out of reach of the crowd, waiting for an opportunity.
Guangfeng leaned down, picked up a black feather on the ground, and stared at it twice.
"Kind of like a crow."
"A crow is so big?!" Ye Shi glanced at the scratches on the wood next to him and said with lingering fear as he backed away.
"This thing should be a mutant...a mutant produced by gamma rays or something else. I've seen the settings on the official website." Fang Chang stared at him cautiously, not daring to relax for a moment.
Ye Shi: "The official website has settings?! Isn't it just a reservation page?"
Kuangfeng: "That was a few days ago... The official website was updated with new features yesterday, didn't you even look at it?"
"Stop talking nonsense, what should we do now? Just do it like this?" Ye Shi took another step back nervously.
Now the closest thing to the bird was the strong wind.
Four people and one bird were in a stalemate.
At this moment, a "swish" sound broke through the air above the four people's heads, and hit the big bird straight towards it.
"Yah!"
Although the stone did not hit it, it frightened the big bird. It flew up and jumped to another tree branch.
When it flapped its wings and finally stabilized its body on the branch, it saw the man on the ground picking up another stone and throwing it towards it.
Big Bird was completely angry.
This is the first time it has seen a guy who dares to be so arrogant to itself in this territory that belongs to it.
The bent legs exerted force suddenly,It jumped up from the tree branch like a fired cannonball and plunged towards Chu Guang.
The sharp claws extend forward like an open hook.
However, a beast is still a beast. Even if it grows another head, it will not be able to understand the sarcasm that curls up the corner of its mouth.
Throwing away the stone in his hand, Chu Guang skillfully grabbed the steel pipe inserted into the ground and plunged the sharp end out.
In the flash of lightning, there was no time to dodge.
Although the big bird fluttered its wings in surprise and tried to distance itself the moment it saw Chu Guang picking up the guy it had never seen before, it was basically impossible to do so under the influence of inertia.
The water pipe was like a javelin, piercing its chest hard.
"Gah——!"
The screams echoed in the forest.
Bloody feathers flew everywhere.
Watching the big bird struggling to fly away, Chu Guang stepped forward silently and picked up the bloody water pipe from the ground.
"This is not a crow."
"Its scientific name was Falcon... about two hundred years ago."
The four players stared at him dumbfounded, stunned by this smooth and flowing movement.
So strong! !
However, they don't know that for the absolute majority of survivors who can walk alone in the wasteland, this level of skill is nothing more than basic skills.
In these five months, Chu Guang has learned nothing else but mastered the skill of throwing a javelin. He can hit wherever he wants within ten meters.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have the chance to stand here and show off.
"Falcon?! Is it so big?" Kuang Feng said in surprise, which overturned his understanding of birds.
The abbot swallowed.
"Because of gamma rays?"
"It's not just gamma rays. Viruses, bacteria, genetic weapons...all kinds of factors have combined to cause everything we see today. Of course, alien species are just one of the threats we face. In some cases, people will be more dangerous than them."
Chu Guang looked up at the pine trees in front of the four players and continued.
"The falcon just now must have made a nest in this tree. No wonder it doesn't leave with so many of you."
Generally speaking, birds rarely take the initiative to provoke ground creatures that are larger than themselves. Their diet mainly consists of mutated cockroaches, mice, and squirrels.
Although the beast flew away, it couldn't fly far and was probably waiting to die in a nearby tree.
Although this type of water pipe with a sharp point does not have strong penetrating power, the hollow inside is a natural bloodletting channel. As long as a hole is pierced in the body, death is almost certain.
Let alone a bird, even if it were a human being, it would be difficult to sew up the wound.
Ye Shi lowered his head in shame.
"Sorry...I was too busy chopping wood to notice."
"No need to be sorry," Chu Guang raised his head and glanced, "Bird eggs are a good thing."
I'll be happy for a while.
Chu Guang's judgment was quickly verified.
Under a crooked-necked tree, he found the dead black bird.
He bled it with a dagger and peeled off its feathers. Chu Guang threw it into an iron pot and placed it on a stove made of bricks. He stuffed dry branches and dead leaves under the stove and lit it with the matches he bought earlier.
Smoke rises.
Before the water boiled, Chu Guang took the blanched bird out of the pot, skewered it with steel bars, and grilled it directly on the fire.
Also roasted together were those bird eggs.
No salt and no spices.
But even so, it's much better than half-cooked green wheat.
"Is this thing... edible?"
Looking at the "mutant" on the iron frame, Ye Shi instinctively felt repelled, but despite the constant teasing scent, he still swallowed in dismay.
You can actually eat in the game!
This is definitely a surprise for foodies.
And this made him instantly feel that all the hard work this morning was worth it.
"You can eat it when it's cooked. I'll tell you what you can't eat." Chu Guang slowly turned the grill so that every side of the food was fully heated.There are not many opportunities to eat wild game in the wasteland.
Even if you occasionally catch edible game like this, it will quickly spoil due to lack of preservation methods.
Here, salt is a more scarce commodity than electricity.
Especially for survivors living in inland cities like Qingquan City, it is unrealistic to use a large amount of salt to pickle food.
As for refrigerators, I heard that there was one in the mayor's castle, but Chu Guang had only heard about it and had never actually seen it.
Of course, the survivors are not completely helpless.
For example, Mr. Brown's farm, the survivor stronghold next door, produces tobacco leaves rich in aromatic compounds such as tar and aldehydes and ketones. Even if smoked without salt, it can extend the shelf life of food by several months.
"Master Manager, please tell me how much wood we need."
Waiting for food to be ready is an ordeal.
In order to divert attention from food, Fang Chang took the initiative
Upon hearing this question, Chu Guang replied casually.
"Cut as many as you can."
The players looked at each other with little enthusiasm.
Chu Guang didn't pay much attention at first, but at this moment, he suddenly thought of something.
They are "players," that is, "outsiders."
Unlike themselves who have traveled here, they can leave here at any time, and there is no urgency to survive.
Even if you tell them the importance of stocking up on wood, they won't really understand what it means.
The player's identity determines that their perspective on thinking about problems is different from their own. Even if they don't mind the liver, it's hard to continue to pay for things that don't pay off.
There is a mission.
Naturally, there must be rewards.
"Let me think about it..."
Chu Guang, who touched his chin, fell into deep thought.
Suddenly, an idea occurred to him.
"At four o'clock in the afternoon, we will tally today's results."
"A tree as thick as an arm will contribute 1 point for each meter of its length. A tree as thick as a thigh will contribute 2 points for each meter -"
However, what Chu Guang didn't expect was that as soon as he finished speaking, four salted fish holding bowls stood up with a loud sound.
"Master Manager, I suddenly feel not very hungry."
"Me too."
"Anyway, there's still a while before dinner starts, so I'm going to plant two more trees!"
"I suddenly want to chop something!"
Chu Guang: "...?"
He hasn't said yet what the contribution points can be used for...
